basis:
Independent arithmetic: with i = 0 every polynomial term vanishes except the constant 3.6 J/kg/m. Ratio 3.6/3.6 = 1.000. Pace 300/1.000 = 300 s/km, rounded to the nearest whole second.

Steps: ["Gradient fraction i = 0 / 100 = 0.", "Cost Cr = 155.4×0⁵ − 30.4×0⁴ − 43.3×0³ + 46.3×0² + 19.5×0 + 3.6 = 3.600 J/kg/m.", "Cost ratio = 3.600 / 3.6 = 1.000.", "Flat-equivalent pace = 300 / 1.000 = 300 s/km; direction is flat."]
Notes: Boundary check at zero gradient: the polynomial reduces to the flat constant, so the cost ratio is 1.000 and the flat-equivalent pace equals the actual pace. This confirms the conversion has no hidden bias on level ground.
